title: The Value of Information in Resource-Constrained Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2603.24974v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dynamic pricing with resource constraints requires balancing exploration of unknown demand patterns against exploitation of known information to maximize revenue. We develop algorithms for this problem across different information regimes. Products share perishable resources, and the firm posts prices and observes the realized requests, which may exceed the remaining capacity. In the full-information setting, a residual-correction policy that solves the fluid problem once attains $O(\log T)$ regret with bounded prices and arbitrary-rank resource matrices. In the no-information setting, deterministic exploration followed by a certainty-equivalent policy attains $O(\sqrt T)$ regret when the limiting fluid solution is nondegenerate. translated_title: 资源受限定价中信息的价值
translated_abstract: 在资源约束下的动态定价中，需要在探索未知需求模式与利用已知信息之间进行权衡，以实现收益最大化。我们针对该问题在不同的信息环境下开发了相应的算法。产品共享易逝性资源，企业发布价格并观察实际到达的需求请求，这些请求可能超过剩余容量。在完全信息环境下，一种仅求解一次流体问题的残差修正策略，在有界价格和任意秩资源矩阵的条件下可达到 O(log T) 的后悔值。在无信息环境下，先进行确定性探索再采用确定性等价策略，当极限流体解非退化时可达到 O(√T) 的后悔值。在知情定价环境下，给定初始的价格-需求估计，若斜率矩阵是对称的，反馈控制器无需估计斜率矩阵即可学习实施价格……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究了资源受限动态定价中的信息价值，在完全信息、无信息和知情定价三种信息环境下分别设计了算法：完全信息下仅求解一次流体问题的残差修正策略达到 O(log T) 后悔值，无信息下确定性探索加确定性等价策略达到 O(√T) 后悔值，知情定价下反馈控制器在斜率矩阵对称时无需估计斜率即可学习最优实施价格。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the value of information in resource-constrained dynamic pricing, developing algorithms across three information regimes: a residual-correction policy achieving O(log T) regret in the full-information setting, deterministic exploration with a certainty-equivalent policy achieving O(√T) regret in the no-information setting, and a feedback controller that learns implementing prices without estimating the slope matrix in the informed-price setting.
